    # Click on the Sales link in the menubar
    sales_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="Sales")
    await sales_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Wait for potential loading and find Orders link
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Allow time for submenu or page load
    # Look for a link with name containing "Orders" (case-insensitive)
    orders_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders", exact=False)
    await orders_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # On Orders page, find the table with orders
    # Assume the table has role "table" and contains rows with cells for items
    table = page.get_by_role("table")
    # Get all rows in the table, skipping the header row if present
    rows = table.get_by_role("row")
    row_count = await rows.count()
    total_items = 0
    # Iterate over the most recent 7 orders (first 7 rows after header, assuming sorted by most recent)
    # Start from index 1 to skip header row, but adjust if no header
    start_index = 1 if row_count > 0 and await rows.nth(0).get_by_role("columnheader").count() > 0 else 0
    for i in range(start_index, min(start_index + 7, row_count)):
        row = rows.nth(i)
        # Find cells in the row
        cells = row.get_by_role("cell")
        cell_count = await cells.count()
        # Assume items count is in a cell that contains only digits (e.g., "5")
        for j in range(cell_count):
            cell = cells.nth(j)
            text = await cell.text_content()
            if text and text.strip().isdigit():
                total_items += int(text.strip())
                break
    # Print the total items as required
    print(total_items)
